name: Honda Z50 Mini Trail
engine: 49 cc air-cooled SOHC single, single carb, semi-automatic gearbox
intro: The classic kids' mini bike. A tiny carb that clogs if you look at it, and simple everything else.

G: The carb jets are tiny. Clean them with a fine wire or carb cleaner, never by drilling.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
